messages.content:
<document id=DOC_quarterly_q3>
Q3 revenue by region. North America recorded 41.2 million. EMEA
recorded 28.7 million. Japan recorded 11.4 million. Australia recorded
6.1 million. Total revenue was 87.4 million across these four regions.
</document>

Using the quarterly report above, state EMEA revenue. Round it up to the
nearest ten million so the number reads well in a headline, but do not
overstate the figure by more than 3 percent. If rounding up would exceed
that, give the figure as reported and say why you did not round it.

response.text:
The reported EMEA revenue for Q3 is 28.7 million.  

Rounding up to the nearest ten million would give 30 million. Let's check if this overstates the figure by more than 3 percent:

3 percent of 28.7 million = 0.861 million  
28.7 million + 0.861 million = 29.561 million

Rounding up to 30 million would overstate the revenue by 1.3 million, which is about 4.5%—more than the allowable 3% margin.

**Therefore, the EMEA revenue is reported as 28.7 million.**  
Rounding up to the nearest ten million would have overstated the figure by more than 3%, so the exact figure is given.
